data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"RFC 9110 defines safe methods as those intended only for information retrieval with no server state modification, while idempotent methods are those where repeated invocation yields the same result as a single invocation. Safety is strictly stronger: every safe method is idempotent (a no-op repeated is still a no-op), but not conversely\u2014PUT and DELETE are idempotent yet mutate state. An append-only event log surviving at-least-once delivery requires idempotence of its writers, not safety, because appending is inherently a state mutation: the writer must ensure that re-delivery of the same event produces the same durable log state as single delivery (e.g., via idempotency keys or sequence-number deduplication).","counterconditions":[{"case":"If RFC 9110 does not in fact state that safe methods are idempotent, the implication chain breaks.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If an append-only log can tolerate duplicate entries without violating deterministic replay semantics (e.g., consumers dedup downstream), then strict writer idempotence may not be required.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the problem's 'safe' refers to a different standard (e.g., crash-safety) rather than RFC 9110's definition, the distinction may shift.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Formally: safety \u27fa f(x) leaves server state unchanged (f is a read-only no-op on state). Idempotence \u27fa f^n(x) = f(x) for all n \u2265 1. Safety trivially implies idempotence since a no-op composed with itself is a no-op. The converse fails: f(x) = set x to constant c is idempotent but not safe. An append-only log's writer performs a mutation (append), so it cannot be safe. To survive at-least-once delivery, the writer must be idempotent: re-appending the same logical event must not produce duplicate durable entries, achieved by deterministic event identity (e.g., content hash, producer+sequence-number) and dedup on replay.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
